title: Events and live streams
description: At Koina the work happens in the open. On stream you see real projects, real PRs and real mistakes.

formats.name: Code Meetup
formats.text: We write code live and discuss topics and ideas. Questions from chat are part of the stream.

formats.name: Open Review
formats.text: A mentor reviews real PRs from community projects live. The fastest way to learn review culture.

formats.name: Koina Workshop
formats.text: A monthly themed session: writing tests, safe code with AI, CI/CD.

formats.name: Mentor AMA
formats.text: Open Q&A on careers, hiring and experience with a senior industry guest.
formats.when: Next up, announced with the guest

formats.name: Demo Day
formats.text: At the end of each season every team demos its v0.1 live.

followText: Turn on notifications on any channel and you will know the moment we go live.
formatsLead: Right now it’s Code Meetup every Saturday. The others open when their turn comes. The bar is relative to the longest format.
